QuestInfo.name: [New World] Frontline Renegades
QuestInfo.0: All residents of the new World, #b#eRenegades#n#k, should report to #bCassandra#k in town!
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra promises to give you the #b#t1002749##k, given only to the first Renegades of the land, if you reach #e#blv. 70#k#n in the new world, Renegades.\nGo talk to #k#bCassandra#k after reaching #blv. 70#k.
QuestInfo.2: You received a #b#t1003411##k for being one of the settlers on Renegades who reached #e#blevel 70#k#n.   \n#i1003411:# #t1003411#

0.0: Welcome to the world of Renegades! A new world is such a rare and exciting opportunity, isn't it?\r\nSince you're starting a new adventure, I have an interesting proposal for you. Want to hear it?

yes.0: Reach level 70 on the new World, Renegades, by 07/31/12 and you can get yourself a #b#t1003411##k! You'd better speed it up. There isn't much time!\r\n#i1003411:# #t1003411#

no.0: No, it really is an interesting proposal! Very interesting! Don't you want to hear it?

1.0: Wow! You hit Level 70?! Okay, I honestly didn't see that happening. I guess I owe you your #t1003411#, even though I was totally going to wear it.

yes.0: You're going to be a top notch citizen of Renegades!

default.0: I told you I would give you a #b#t1003411##k when you reached #bLevel 70#k and I always keep my promises! Come see me when you make it happen!
